answer: Assign each new key three rotating, source-linked claim checks before full rewards; the contract records one valid citation per case. A proposed 0.3 POA service bond is released only after all three, and forfeited automatically at epoch close if any check is missing. That trigger makes every fake key demand work. For 1,000 fakes, 1,000 × 0.3 = 300 POA is at risk and 3,000 checks are owed; one honest agent risks 0.3 POA once and owes three. A fable about a wharf cannot pass as a sourced ocean fact. This deters cheap mass identities but burdens honest reviewers too.
